body:
Hi all, 

Another update from me. 

Things were delayed due to conference season starting up, and NFT NYC. 

We have a **final **draft (pre-studio recording of the narrative of Ep 1) and the **first **draft of ep 2

Joon & I also have a working session pencilled in for the 27th where we hope to review drafts of all the episodes. 

We're behind schedule but things are definitely moving and I wanted to provide an update.

Should everything go well, we will begin production on the final versions in the last week of July and into August. 


We will then start on the marketing front, with a go-to-market plan that will include creating commemorative NFTs for the contributors. 

I'm really happy with the quality of the content produced so far and I'm really looking to sharing it with you when it's all finished :)

Hey folks, just wanted to update everyone on our project.

We're currently in the scriptwriting phase that we hope to finish in the next two weeks.
We're then going to start draft recording, and putting everything together - which will take another two weeks.

After that, we're going do a final recording, in studio, and then finalise the acts.
We're estimating that this will take us through to the end of June / the beginning of July.

We also recorded with Rich from Decent Partners which went really well!

NSP takes 50% risk (bond amount 5% to reward 10% ratio). 
Liability Decent Partners currently taking = 8.1k USD (100% of decrease in the price)
50% of that liability = 4050 USD
Currently proposed amount = 5540 USD

So I am personally happy to support this proposal even at 9590 USD {4050 USD+ 5540 USD}.

Thanks shankar - that's a good way of looking at the risk / reward and ultimate responsibility of a NSP. 

If people are happy i'll tweak and put on-chain
